content:
Salvation is beyond mere forgiveness of sins, salvation in Christ is the removal of the sin nature and all that it came with, it is freedom from sickness, bondage and all the power of the devil. This is what it means to be saved by Jesus Christ, as He comes into your life He brings Joy, Peace, health and prosperity. You are in Christ a partaker of divinity.
_2Pe 1:4 Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust_
*#GraceGalore*

Grace is not a sermon or a teaching, Grace is the person of Jesus Christ manifest and His work for the believer experienced in our day to day lives. It is the revelation of the person and work of Christ, that allows one to function in the total blessing that God has for them. The grace of God is at Work in you today. 
_Joh 1:17 For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ._
*#GraceGalore*

Let Jesus' love for you flood your heart and mind, meditate on His Love for you, you will realise that there is so much you haven't taken advance of, you will find His love is so much more than you have fathomed so far. God so loves you, you are loved and pursued!
_Eph 3:19 And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fullness of God._
*#GraceGalore*

There is no legitimate reason to worry, worry is a clear reflection that one is not looking unto the Lord, it shows that one has not fathomed the Fathers love. Once you are convicted of the Love that God has for you, you will be fully convinced that He is so concerned about you, He cares for you and He has your best interests at heart. You can't worry and trust God at the same time; Give it all to Him. 
_1Pe 5:7 Casting all your care upon Him; for He careth for you._
*#GraceGalore*

Reading the Word of God is not a religious duty, it is not just about going through the Christian Holy scriptures. The Word of God is the material that made everything that we see, it is the Power that brings forth success and victory in those who trust in the Lord. You trust God to the degree that you trust His word. We are born of the Word, it is the source who we are. 
_2Sa 22:31 As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: He is a buckler to all them that trust in Him._
*#GraceGalore*

Every religion tries to bring mankind back to a relationship with God, There are varies duties and deeds with are prescribed to its followers to make them feel close or connected to a divine being. In Christ it is not so, once one gives their heart to Him, they are granted righteousness as a gift, and we now operate from a position of right standing with God. You are at peace with God, by faith in Jesus Christ. 
_Rom 5:1 Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ_
*#GraceGalore*

The same God who saves you is the same one who heals and provides all your needs. He is who He is, He cannot do one part and not do the other. Many are sure of His salvation, but feel He is not that willing to Heal or provide for them financially. The way to get connected to this reality is to look in to the Word and find out the nature of God, see His Love for you and know His heart towards you. 
_Psa 103:2-3 Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits, Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;_
*#GraceGalore*

Follow through on the things that you have received from the Lord, don't just hear His voice, run in the direction of the word. A lot of people have heard God speak to them and give them ideas that they have never followed through. The Blessing is in responding to the Word of God, look at Abraham; when the Lord asked Him to do something He followed it through to the end, thus he is the father of Faith.
_Rom 4:3 For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness._
*#GraceGalore*

Families, nation's and relationships are only as strong as they share common values and communicate freely with each other, so it is in the Kingdom, our communication between us as believer and with the Lord is built on this premise, the Father has Given us the word what we may know who we are and be built up on it. Our oneness with Christ is revealed to us, and we abide in His word. 
_Joh 8:31 Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed_
*#GraceGalore*

God loves you and believes you are worth so much, don't value yourself based on your current achievements or what you have accumulated over the years. The word of God is what determines your worth, you are who and what God says you are, take your stance in life and live on the of the word of God, confess it as your reality. You see what the Word says 
_Jas 1:25 But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed._
*#GraceGalore*

The work is already done, you are not trying to get God interested in your life or your affairs now, He has already done and provided everything that you'll ever need to have a blessed and successful life in Christ. This is why our prayers and filled with Thanks, when we make requests we make them on the basis of what He has already provided for us in His word and by the work of Christ, and in this we give thanks.
_Eph 1:3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:_
*#GraceGalore*

Don't lose hope sight of what you desire of the Lord, God gives us what we desire when we look to Him. Jesus ensures us that we can experience His power and divine change in our lives because He has given us His Name and the authority of His name. All creation responds to the delegated authority of the Believer in the Name of Jesus. Exercise your rights today.
_Joh 14:13 And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son_
*#GraceGalore*

You are called to heritage a blessing in Christ, when you accepted Jesus as you Lord and Savior the package comes with an inherited blessing. You are blessed in Christ, this is your life, there is no curse in Him. The devils greatest tool is deception he tries to keep us blinded from the reality that is our Christ, but we are not ignorant of his schemes, we know who we are in Christ, we are Blessed! 
_Eph 1:3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ_
*#GraceGalore*

God's power is infinite and immeasurable. When He says He shall do something, it is not a question of ability, what most people struggle with is God's willingness to do, they know He is all powerful but when it comes to His willingness they look at themselves and wonder if the have earned it, but the truth is just as He is infinite in Power His is also Infinite in Love. He has qualified you by the blood of Jesus, accept that and experience the power of God! 
_Mat 8:3 And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed_
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus is the Way, the Truth and the Life. Many people ask God to make a way, but that is already a done deal, the way has already been made, all God asks us to do is to walk therein. We don't ask God to make a way, all we do is thank Him for what He has already provided for us in Christ; we find it in His word and walk it out. All that you need is provided.
_Joh 14:6 Jesus saith unto him, I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me_
*#GraceGalore*

Your voice is significant in the Earth, your words are creative material, they set things into motion, they are what frame the reality that you are to experience. This Is because we were made in the likeness and Image of God, He is a creator, and He does it by His Words. Be intentional with your Words, Speak out the reality that you desire!!
_Pro 18:21 Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof._
*#GraceGalore*

God is concerned about what concerns you, He pays attention to your life, He can take better care for you than you ever can, trust Him and cast your cares upon Him. This does not mean you become irresponsible, but it does entail that God is the source of your life and you are entrusting your life into His care and provision. 
_1Pe 5:7 Casting all your care upon Him; for He careth for you_
*#GraceGalore*

There is a mighty army of Angels that are awaiting your words to be sent in the direction that you need help. They are sent and assigned by God to watch over Heavens interests in the Earth. Your Father is very much concerned about you, that He has setup angelic structures around about you for your good and advancement. Acknowledge and Engage them today. 
_Psa 91:11 For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways._
*#GraceGalore*

The ministry of angels is very sensitive to words, what are you saying even when no one is watching, when you speak words of Life over a particular situation, angels are activated in your favor, they go forth to bring that thing to pass, but if change your confession about it and became negative, they stop working, this is why the Bible admonishes us to keep our confession, and not be double minded.
_Psa 103:20 Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word._
*#GraceGalore*

There is no need to go through life on your own strength and ability, there is a Heavenly host that is more than willing to help you get the connections you need and the advantage in your field. There is comfort that comes with the angelic presence around your life, it will keep depression and anxiety from oppressing your mind. Acknowledge and Engage them today.
_Mat 4:11 Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him._
*#GraceGalore*

There is more going on around you than what meets the eye, there are angels that stand by, to ensure that it goes well with you. You have unseen help from on high, there is no reason to fear or be concerned the Lord has His angels given charge over you. Fear is what disables their ability and effectiveness in our lives, this is why when angels appeared in the Bible one of the first things they said was 'fear not'. Acknowledge and Engage them today. 
_Luk 1:30 And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God._
*#GraceGalore*

The Angels marvel at the fact of the gift of God to mankind, when they behold the fact that He did it all because of the Love He has for you. This Easter remember your value, you are so valuable to God that He showed us He greatest love and power in the Death, Burial and Resurrection of Jesus. The angels know how precious this is that there is rejoicing in Heaven when one gives their life to Christ.
_Luk 15:10 Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a glory that the angels of God carry with them, as they behold God Almighty something rubs off on them and when they come around our lives they release this glory that into the affairs of our lives. Many know the negative effects of a demon in a home, but they have not been taught about engaging angels over your family and as they comes they release Glory of God, that entails peace, serenity, joy and favour Acknowledge and Engage them. 
_Mat 18:10 ..That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven._
*#GraceGalore*

The work of the enemy around your life can be kept at bay by the the hosts of Heaven. When we pray to God and engage Him over our affairs, angels are sent and they keep out the plot and schemes of the enemy. One angel is enough to stop hordes of demons. Your help is here. Acknowledge and Engage them.
_Jud 1:9 Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee._
*#GraceGalore*

There is no need to try so hard to put yourself out there by your own ability, let the Lord announce you, you don't have to give yourself a name, there is angelic agency that can announce you, your business or ministry to others. An angel announced Peter to Cornelius, it was angels that sung announcing the birth of Christ! You have divine advertisement. Acknowledge and Engage them.
_Luke 2:10-11 And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a place where we have been called to function in God, it is the heritage of every believer, but we need to desire that which the Lord also desires for us. All that God has called you and I to be is already available, we were made partakers of it in Christ, but now we must come up to our position in Christ.
_Eph 1:18 The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints_
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus Christ is the king of kings and the Lord of Lords, He is the ruler of all creation, yet for you to experience the benefits of this you must acknowledge Jesus for yourself, the revelation should be personal; you must experience and relate to Him as your King and Lord, that's when the power and effects will flow, the will and purposes of God will function in your life. 
_Rev 19:16 And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS_
*#GraceGalore*

Your labour for the Lord is not in vain, He sees you, He sees your efforts, they are so precious in Heaven, your prayers are a sweet smelling aroma before the throne of God. Beloved don't give up and be discouraged, your reward is of the Lord, you may not get an applause from men but know for sure your Heavenly Father sees you. Press On. 
_1Co 15:58 Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a specific and definite plan for your life, God has preordained a path you that is marked with success, fulfillment and joy. You don't have to live by trial and error, there is a place for you in the world. The Word of God is a lamp unto your feet and a light unto YOUR path, He lights up that specific path as you give yourself to the Word. You are here on purpose, for a great purpose 
_Eph 2:10 For we are His workmanship created in Christ Jesus for good works which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them_
*#GraceGalore*

The faithfulness of God is not dented by the failures of man. Don't judge God based on what a man failed to do, look to Him and allow His power and Grace to wash over you. Jesus never fails, let your faith rest in that reality, let Jesus' Love be your anchor and foundation in life. What you have lost or gained is not the definition of God's love for you. His love for us is seen in His sending Jesus our Lord and Savior. 
_Psa 18:2 The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower_
*#GraceGalore*

The ways of the Lord are perfect, the Lord Perfects all that concerns us, it is important to place all things into His perfect hands, His strength is perfect, He love is unending, His Power is infinite. You can entrust your life into the hands of this all loving and caring God! He sees you where you are and He has the best for you. Come to Him, give it all to Jesus. 
_1Pe 5:7 Casting all your care upon Him; for He careth for you._
*#GraceGalore*

The Lord is the only one with the blueprint of your life, you cannot live your life trying to please man, or trying to attain the standards of man. Don't judge yourself based on the progress or failure of others. Your timing is of God! The success of others does not mean you are failing, your path is different, you are in a different race. Be you and do you!
_Ecc 3:11 He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end._
*#GraceGalore*

The world is not designed to favor passivity, you have to be radical to make impact on the world, even nature dictates that the greater the force the great the impact and results. Believe in your dreams and pursue them viciously, don't try them out sheepishly, be fervent, run with purpose and vigor.
_Rom 12:11 Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;_
*#GraceGalore*

Don't do life on the defensive, be proactive, take life head on, make things happen, don't just take everything that happens to you, step up and determine what you want out of life and stay focused. God made man to have dominion over all the Earth, we are here not to be impacted but to impact creation. The World is yours for the taking.
_Mat 11:12 And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of Heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus came even for the worst of men, He is not just Lord of believers, He is Lord of All. Many people have given their lives as martyrs for the cause of their religious or political beliefs, but no one in all existence has ever died for everyone, to make an all inclusive sacrifice for all humanity. Jesus is for everyone, we have a message for the whole world.
_Mar 16:15 And He said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the Gospel to every creature._
*#GraceGalore*

God knows you, He knows your heart and the motives of your life, while man will judge you based on your actions, God judges the motives behind the actions, He sees your heart. Be conscious about your heart, don't do things that only man can see and applaud you for, seek to touch the heart of God! 
_Pro 16:2 All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits_
*#GraceGalore*

In Christ what God says we are is what defines us, according to the world we are defined by what we do. The definition that comes from what one does is temporal and leads to condemnation. Define yourself based on the immovable Word of God! It is the only constant thing in all existence, hold your reality is that! You are the righteousness of God in Christ!
_Psa 119:89 Forever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven_
*#GraceGalore*

The blessings of the Lord is on the Word, there is fruit that will manifest in the life of the believer who gives himself to the Word as his possession. Don't lose sight of what the Lord has said over your life, press into it by Faith, and experience the Word of God in your everyday life. 
_Psa 106:12 Then believed they His words; they sang His praise._
*#GraceGalore*

Giving is the mindset of a believer, we should be on the giving end in life. It is more fulfilling to live your life of a giver, than to always look out for what you can get out of life. As you go throughout your day, look out for opportunities to give someone something, whether it's a compliment or a physical gift. You have something to give.
_Act 20:35.. and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how He said, It is more blessed to give than to receive._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a word from the Lord for you today, God's word is the food that the believer needs daily. It is what takes us to the next level is our life's, it is the nourishment that we need to be strong in our walk with Christ. God's word is alive it is substance, it is the material that He uses to change our lives and establish us in the Earth. Go for the word. 
_Act 20:32 And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a light in you, all the darkness in the world cannot put it out, don't look at the all the bad things going on in the world and see hopelessness, rather see opportunity for your rising, you were born for this, you were placed by God in this generation to bring about this very change. Live for that higher purpose. 
_Isa 60:2 For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and His glory shall be seen upon thee_
*#GraceGalore*

Who you are on the inside is more valuable than what you possess physically, don't define yourself by what you do or do not have, you are worth what Jesus paid to purchase you, you are worth the precious blood of Jesus. That God would give His sinless, spotless Son to purchase you, shows what infinite worth He places on you, there is nothing in this world too good for you.
_1Co 6:20 For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's._
*#GraceGalore*

Go forth in the strength of who God has made you to be, never slacken in your purpose. That the progress seems slow is immaterial, there is too much at stake, Jesus has placed you at the right place at the right time for a Great cause, never lose sight of that! There is a mission you have to fulfil, give it your all. 
_Eph 2:10 For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them_
*#GraceGalore*

As a believer your Words are powerful, they are empowered by the Spirit of God within you, nothing can hold you back, there is no force of nature or of hell that can withstand the Word of God in the mouth of a believer. Fill your heart with the Word and it will come out of your spirit everytime. The Power to change any situation and line it up with the Word is in your mouth. 
_Rom 10:8 But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach_
*#GraceGalore*

Grace opens doors that effort will never open for you, Grace can cause things to move that one's ability can not, Grace places you in positions where qualifications never can. Grace is more powerful than your abilities, it is more recognizable than your credentials. Jesus is the Person of Grace, that is who He is, His power is endless, He brings glory and esteem to every area of your life. 
_2Co 12:9 And He said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for My strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a power that draws you to God, and keeps you connected to abundant Grace, it is not your good deeds, it is His Love. The bond between you and God is not your holiness, it is His Love, what makes you a child of God is His Love for you. Love is what Brought us in and it is also what keeps us in fellowship with God. Rest in His Love.
_Jer 31:3 The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee_
*#GraceGalore*

There is no place for darkness in Christ, and as a believer you must confess and walk in this truth. Darkness and all it represents can not find you in Christ, when you gave your life to Christ He became the light of your life, all that pertains to you is illuminated by His light. Walk in the Light, it is your natural state. 
_Joh 8:12 Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life_
*#GraceGalore*

Celebrate the success and achievement of others, envy and jealousy brings more harm to you, it is not a motivation, rather it distracts you from seeing all the blessings all around you, and keeps you in a place that will never be satisfied. We are not in the same race in Life, run your race at your God ordained pace, and succeed in your dreams. 
_Ecc 9:11 I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all_
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus is the Hope of the World, in the world today there is so much that could cause us to be in despair, looking around it seems things keep getting worse, the systems of man are failing, and those who trust in them will fall too. This in time to put your trust in Jesus, He is the only hope of Glory, His kingdom never fails, His ways are unchanging. 
_Psa 118:8 It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man._
*#GraceGalore*

You cannot be a believer and not live a life of Joy and peace, Trusting God is the only sure way to total fulfillment in life. There is no shame and loss for the one who placed his trust in the Lord! They that put their Trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion that cannot be moved. Joy and Peace are your portion in life. 
_Rom 15:13 Now the God of hope fill you with all Joy and Peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost_
*#GraceGalore*
